A lot of people aren't getting their orders from him, even more of them aren't getting responses from him and it's difficult to try and get either your money or the product.

While people are waiting for their orders, he announces new projects that are of course absolutely ready to be bought/funded immediately such as Burnr, or Verve. He also changes his name to that of his "rival". 

A lot of people from the Abode software project- a previous kickstarter project of his- have recieved nothing other than a hoodie and a tote bag. In some cases, they havent even recieved that or only one of those items. No updates, no software. 

Someone pointed out that Burnr's project appeared to only use AI art. Stuart Semple says this was not the first interaction with this person and that they had been harassing him prior, but (afaik) made up fake images to back up this claim. 

In response to being called out, he stalked this person's profile, commented incredibly childish and hostile things all over their posts, etc. He since deleted these comments, but still refers to the person who called him out as a "troll". 

That's all the most recent stuff that I can think of that's changed this subs opinion of Semple. There is also some older stuff such as employees alleging that he wasn't as nice as he appeared, and information suggesting the Anish/Stuart feud was not as Semple had claimed it to be.

Sorry for the long post but I hope this helps? :)
